Summer Dancer (Korean: 썸머댄서, sseommeodaenseo) is Melon Mlem's first Costume, released in the first half of the Summer Party at Marine Soda Bay! update. It is an Epic Costume that can only be obtained through a Pet Costume package in the Package Shop.

Story

Melon Mlem jumped right in to help promote Cafe Fruit Bomber's new watermelon punch! Topped with a dollop of cream and a slice of watermelon, it bounces and dances its way between the Cookies to hype them up... It may not have a sense of rhythm, but who cares as long as it looks like its having fun!

Trivia

  • Summer Dancer was released alongside  Watermelon PUNCH!,  Beachside Party, and  Seaside Memories.
